NAME: Use letters only. Spaces, hyphens, apostrophes and dots are allowed.
DATE_OF_BIRTH: Enter a real date of birth in the past.
PASSWORD_WEAK: Use at least one letter and one number.
PROVIDER_TYPE: Choose a provider type: Restaurant, Hotel, Trip agency, Event manager or Tour guide.
PROVIDER_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED: Only providers choose a provider type. Remove this field for tourist accounts.
RESET_TOKEN: Paste the full reset code you received.
ADMIN_ROLE: Choose a role: Super admin, Admin, Moderator or Support.
ADMIN_PERMISSION: Contains an unknown permission. See GET /admin/options for the allowed values.
BOOKING_CATEGORY: Choose hotels, dining, trips, events or guides.
BOOKING_STATUS: Choose pending, confirmed, checkedIn, completed, cancelled, noShow or disputed.
PROVIDER_STATUS: Choose pending, approved, rejected or suspended.
PROVIDER_CATEGORY: Choose hotels, dining, trips, events or guides.
GOVERNORATE: Choose damascus, aleppo, latakia, tartus, homs, hama, palmyra or bosra.
DISPUTE_RESOLUTION: Choose resolvedGuest (the guest is right) or resolvedProvider (the provider is right).
OBJECT: Must be an object with en and ar.
RATE: Enter a rate from 0 to 1 with at most 4 decimals (0.085 means 8.5%).
LEDGER_STANDING: Choose healthy, watch, grace or suspended.
IMAGE_URL: Use an https image link, or a path starting with /.
FEATURED_SLOT: Choose one of the home page slots.
DATE_RANGE: The end date can't be before the start date.
COUPON_SCOPE: Choose provider, listing, pillar or platform.
COUPON_STATUS: Choose scheduled, live, ended or disabled.
COUPON_CODE: Use 3 to 16 letters or digits, with no other characters.
DISCOUNT_VALUE: Enter a whole number: 1 to 100 for a percent discount, or an amount in pounds for a fixed one.
COUNT: Enter a whole number from 1 up, or leave it empty for no limit.
COUPON_SCOPE_ID: Use letters, digits and - _ . : only (up to 100 characters).
SCORE_ORDER: The scores must go down: VIP above standard above restricted.
SEARCH_TYPE: Choose heritageSite, provider, category or region.
RELIABILITY_TIER: Choose vip, standard, restricted or suspended.
